text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, and E after gains felt rewarding, but a gain versus my cost basis alone does not show whether selling is the best choice now.","I later bought B, C, and E again at higher prices; I should avoid letting regret or the urge to recover a sold position drive a trade.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should make decisions using risk, diversification, and my overall portfolio plan—not assume a recent trend will continue."]}
